title: Lottie
summary: Small vector accents in the theme look: flat shapes with a fat ink outline and a hard offset shadow, generated from code in lottie/generate.mjs.

items.name: Sun rise
items.description: A striped sun rises over teal water as its rays switch on.

items.name: Palm sway
items.description: A palm leaning in the breeze, inked, on a patch of sand.

items.name: Wave loop
items.description: Three inked wave lines sliding past each other.

items.name: Sun spinner
items.description: A sun whose rays turn while it breathes: loading, thinking, hold on.

items.name: Beat bars
items.description: Inked equaliser bars in sunset colours rising and falling.

items.name: Speed lines
items.description: Streaks rushing sideways: fast, hurry, in motion.

items.name: Arrow bounce
items.description: A fat arrow bouncing downward: look here, link below.

items.name: Burst pop
items.description: A starburst pops with a star inside and sparks flying.

items.name: Check stamp
items.description: A disc slams in and a tick is drawn across it.

items.name: Heart beat
items.description: A heart with a double beat and rings pulsing outward.

items.name: Star meter
items.description: Three stars popping into their slots one after another.

items.name: Coin flip
items.description: A gold coin flipping in the air above its shadow.

items.name: Pin drop
items.description: A map pin drops, squashes and sends out rings.
